options.name: hotfix_identifier
options.description: The name of the hotfix as shown in DISM, see examples for details. This or C(hotfix_kb) MUST be set when C(state=absent). If C(state=present) then the hotfix at C(source) will be validated against this value, if it does not match an error will occur. You can get the identifier by running 'Get-WindowsPackage -Online -PackagePath path-to-cab-in-msu' after expanding the msu file.

options.name: hotfix_kb
options.description: The name of the KB the hotfix relates to, see examples for details. This or C(hotfix_identifier) MUST be set when C(state=absent). If C(state=present) then the hotfix at C(source) will be validated against this value, if it does not match an error will occur. Because DISM uses the identifier as a key and doesn't refer to a KB in all cases it is recommended to use C(hotfix_identifier) instead.

options.name: source
options.description: The path to the downloaded hotfix .msu file. This MUST be set if C(state=present) and MUST be a .msu hotfix file.

options.name: state
options.description: Whether to install or uninstall the hotfix. When C(present), C(source) MUST be set. When C(absent), C(hotfix_identifier) or C(hotfix_kb) MUST be set.
